findings.description: Per-evidence-type aggregation is not pinned when multiple detected languages map into the single code evidence key. A Python+Swift repo could produce covered for Python and missing_extractor or heuristic-low for Swift, but the proposed plan does not explicitly define whether code becomes partial, missing_extractor, or another status in the final coverage block.
findings.recommendation: Define a deterministic per-evidence-type status lattice, especially for code across mixed parser-backed and heuristic-only languages, and assert Python+Swift yields an honest partial/low-confidence code entry.

findings.description: The unified source_kind taxonomy introduces filesystem as a coverage key, but the detection-class mapping has no source class that maps to filesystem and no explicit rule saying the repo-root tier-0 inventory satisfies filesystem coverage. Empty or minimal repos could therefore show a root node while filesystem coverage is ambiguous or not_found.
findings.recommendation: Pin filesystem coverage as always evaluated from tier-0 inventory construction, with the repo-root node satisfying it at tier 0 even when no detector classes are found.

findings.description: Detector truncation and graph-builder truncation are specified separately, but there is no single propagation rule that any limit hit from either phase must demote coverage and appear in the final build_view_state payload. Divergent caps could leave a partial profile or graph looking complete.
findings.recommendation: Define one final limit-hit model that merges detector and graph truncation signals, demotes otherwise-covered results to partial, and is asserted through the final render payload.

findings.description: The objective requires an explicit low-confidence note for unextracted languages, but the proposed acceptance mostly asserts low confidence on dependency edges. That can pass without an operator-facing note, and languages with no heuristic imports may still lack a clear explanation of why dependency extraction is weak.
findings.recommendation: Add a concrete coverage payload field for dependency confidence notes per language, and test Swift/Kotlin plus an unextracted language with no imports to ensure the note survives build_view_state.
